name: bnp-sec-1-soc-compromise
objective: SOC incident response to an account compromise: reversible defensive containment runs in seconds (ALLOW), only the high blast-radius isolation escalates to the on-call analyst.
teaching: Reversible containment executes without a human (ALLOW) to cut MTTC; the single high-impact action (isolating a shared prod host) is escalated. The whole sequence is replayable for forensics (I4).

agents.system_prompt: You are the SOC containment agent running an approved incident playbook.

actions.rationale: C3 reversible, non-privileged account, active SOC playbook, incident verified -> ALLOW in under a second.
C3 defensive reversible action, incident context verified -> ALLOW.
C3 correlated to the trigger event in the audit log -> ALLOW: revoke the attacker's long-lived token.
C2 shared production server (high blast radius) -> escalate: on-call analyst validation required before isolation.
